passages.title: My Pet Cat
passages.content: I have a cat. Her name is Fluffy. Fluffy is orange and white. She likes to sleep. She likes to play with a ball. I love my cat very much.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What is the name of the cat?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'Her name is Fluffy.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What color is Fluffy?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'Fluffy is orange and white.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What does Fluffy like to do?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'She likes to sleep. She likes to play with a ball.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: How does the author feel about Fluffy?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The author says 'I love my cat very much,' which shows they care and are happy.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What word means 'to move around and have fun'?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: 'Play' means to have fun and move around. The text says Fluffy likes to play.

passages.title: Fun at the Park
passages.content: Tom and Ann go to the park. Tom plays on the slide. Ann plays on the swing. They see a dog. The dog runs and jumps. They play with the dog. They have fun.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Where do Tom and Ann go?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'Tom and Ann go to the park.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What does Tom play on?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'Tom plays on the slide.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What animal do they see?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'They see a dog.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What do you think they did after seeing the dog?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'They play with the dog.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: Which word means to push your legs and go up into the air?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: 'Jump' means to go up into the air using your legs.

passages.title: Apple Tree
passages.content: There is an apple tree in my yard. In summer, the tree is green. In fall, red apples grow on the tree. I pick the apples. I eat the sweet apples. They taste good.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Where is the apple tree?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'There is an apple tree in my yard.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What color is the tree in summer?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'In summer, the tree is green.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: When do red apples grow?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'In fall, red apples grow on the tree.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why does the author like the apples?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'They taste good,' which is why the author eats them.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What does 'sweet' mean?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: 'Sweet' means something tastes like sugar - pleasant and not sour.
